title: The Natural spring in the wood
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：natural　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 natural 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the nurse wrote of ① a natural spring in the wood in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so natural that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the natural ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the natural spring in the wood that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too natural to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the natural ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a natural gift for languages, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as natural as the gift for languages they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was natural or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something natural, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite natural; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the natural ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, in silence, she wrote of another natural spring in the wood in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less natural than anybody had expected. ⑩ The natural gift for languages that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the natural ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自然（前置定语 a natural spring in the wood：1969 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件自然的天然泉）
B. adj. 自然／天生（两处加强说法：so natural that … 与 no less natural than …）
C. adj. 自然／天生（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自然（表语 too natural to do：母亲觉得它太自然，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 天生（前置定语 a natural gift for languages：叔叔把整件事称作一桩天生的语言天赋）
F. adj. 天生（同级比较 as natural as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩天生的语言天赋相比）
G. adj. 天生（后置定语 something natural：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 天生（受程度副词修饰 quite natural：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a natural spring in the wood
the natural spring in the wood that
The natural gift for languages that

answers.why: natural 意为“自然”，1969 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件自然的天然泉”，此处作前置定语 a natural spring in the wood。
natural 意为“自然”，此处用 so natural that 结构，说它自然到病房里没人敢靠近。
natural 意为“自然”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的自然林中的天然泉，等于最高级的说法。
natural 意为“自然”，母亲认为这件东西“太自然了，谁也用不上”，too natural to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
natural 意为“天生”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩天生的语言天赋”，此处作前置定语 a natural gift for languages。
natural 意为“天生”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩天生的语言天赋一样天生”，同级比较用 as natural as。
natural 意为“天生”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“天生的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something natural。
natural 意为“天生”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当天生”，quite 修饰原级 natural。
natural 意为“天生”，no less natural than 表示“其天生不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之天生不亚于任何人的预料。
natural 意为“天生”，母亲 1981 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的天生语言天赋”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件自然的天然泉。（a natural spring in the wood）
它自然到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so natural that …）
母亲觉得它太自然，谁也用不上。（too natural to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩天生的语言天赋。（a natural gift for languages）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩天生的语言天赋一样天生。（as natural as …）
到了 1976 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件天生的东西。（something natural）
answers: In 1969 the nurse wrote of a natural spring in the wood in the report.
It was so natural that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too natural to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a natural gift for languages.
He said nobody would call it as natural as the gift for languages they had once had.
By 1976 the report asked for nothing but something natural.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 natural 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the nurse wrote of a natural spring in the wood in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the natural spring in the wood that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too natural to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a natural gift for languages, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite natural, and everybody laughed.
The natural ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
